lines.text: Where the king's decree reaches, Jews fast and weep, and Mordecai refuses the clothes Esther sends him.
Hathach learns from Mordecai how much money Haman promised and receives a copy of the Law of Moses.

wrong_details.wrong: a copy of the Law of Moses
wrong_details.true: a copy of the written decree

lines.text: Uninvited visitors to the inner court die unless the king extends the scepter; Esther was not summoned for forty days.
